name: Heinz Homestyle Savory Turkey Gravy (Low-Fat)
whyItWorks: Smooth turkey broth velouté with only 1g of fat per serving and zero fiber. Provides savory holiday roast flavor without heavy pan drippings or greasy butter.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Heat and pour over sliced roast turkey and white bread.
watchOuts: Gentle comfort food for sensitive recovery periods.
